info.title: Inventory System API
info.description: Nigeria health supply-chain inventory API. Contract: docs/API_CONTRACT.md.

get.summary:
Alerts for every facility in the caller's scope, most severe first.
Without a status filter, returns alerts still needing attention
(open and acknowledged)

parameters.name: facility_id
parameters.description: Narrow to one facility within your scope.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Mark an open alert as seen and being handled. No-op if already acknowledged

Close an alert. If the stock situation still holds, it is not raised
again until it clears and recurs. No-op if already resolved
Exchange credentials for a Sanctum bearer token

device_name.description: Label for the token, e.g. "web" or a phone model.

post.summary: Revoke the token used for this request

get.summary: The current user, their role, and the hierarchy node they are anchored at
A facility's delivery notes, newest first

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Create a delivery note — a draft, or confirmed straight away with
confirm=true (the phone's reviewed scan). 201 when created; 200 with
the existing note when client_reference repeats one already sent
Post a draft's items to the ledger as receipts

Register (or clear, with null) the push token of the device the user is
signed in on. Tokens rotate, so the app sends it on every sign-in and
foreground (mobile/CLAUDE.md rule 4)

token.description: FCM registration token; null to stop pushes to this user (e.g. on sign-out).

get.description:
Computed live from stock_balances — fine at LGA scale, and it carries
per-product batch detail. State/Federal aggregate facility_product_status.
get.summary:
LGA rollup: totals per product, how many facilities carry each flag,
and the facility drill-down list sorted worst-first

facility_count.description: Same as child_count here; the facility total at State and Federal level.

facility_counts.description: Number of child facilities with at least one product carrying each flag.

facility_status.description: Facilities by their most serious issue, each counted once.

get.summary: The product catalog. Not hierarchy-scoped: every role sees the same catalog

Quantity to order per product stocked at the facility: latest AMC
snapshot against current usable stock. Products needing an order
come first, lowest months of stock first
State rollup: how many facilities carry each flag, per-product totals, and the LGAs worst first

facility_counts.description: Number of facilities with at least one product carrying each flag.

facility_status.description: Facilities by their most serious issue, each counted once.

get.summary: National rollup: every state, worst first

facility_counts.description: Number of facilities with at least one product carrying each flag.

facility_status.description: Facilities by their most serious issue, each counted once.

get.summary: States visible to the caller (all for federal/admin, own state for state officers, none below that)
Stock Card entries per week across the LGA's facilities the caller can see
Stock Card entries per week across the state's facilities the caller can see
Stock Card entries per week nationally
Stock Card entries per week at one facility (received / issued / other)

Current stock at a facility: one entry per product with its batches,
straight from stock_balances, plus usable/expired split and flags

Ledger history (the Stock Card) for a facility, paginated.
With product_id and order=asc it reads exactly like the paper card

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Record a Stock Card entry. Authorization (StockTransactionPolicy@create)
runs in StoreStockTransactionRequest::authorize(), before validation.
201 when recorded; 200 with the existing entry when client_reference
repeats one already recorded at this facility

condition_active.description: False once the stock situation that raised the alert has cleared.

resolved_by_name.description: Null when resolved automatically because the condition cleared.

AlertType.description: Same values as alerts.alert_type in docs/DATABASE_SCHEMA.md.
AlertType.title: AlertType

reporting_facility_count.description: Facilities with at least one product on the Stock Card.

flag_counts.description: Number of facilities with at least one product carrying each flag.

needs_reorder_count.description: Facilities with at least one product at or below reorder level.

stock_out_products.description: Products stocked out at the most facilities here, top 3.

stock_transaction_id.description: The receipt this line became, once confirmed.

last_transaction_date.description: Date of the facility's most recent Stock Card entry, if any.

flag_counts.description: Number of this facility's products carrying each flag.

needs_reorder_count.description: Products at or below reorder level (includes low stock and stock-outs).

flagged_products.description: Products with any flag or at/below reorder level.

facility_counts.description: Number of facilities where this product carries each flag.

facilities_needing_reorder.description: Facilities where this product is at or below reorder level.

quantity_on_hand.description: Sum of stock_balances.quantity_on_hand across batches, including expired stock.

usable_quantity.description: On hand minus expired batches; thresholds are judged on this.

amc_quantity.description: Average Monthly Consumption (issues per month); null without a complete month of history.

amc_months_used.description: Complete months the AMC is averaged over.

amc_period_month.description: Month of the AMC snapshot used (YYYY-MM-DD, first of month); null if none computed yet.

months_of_stock.description: Usable stock divided by AMC; null without an AMC.

max_stock_quantity.description: Target stock level: AMC x max months, or the product's max_stock_level without an AMC.

suggested_quantity.description: Max stock minus usable stock, never negative.

StockLevel.description: Where a product's *usable* (unexpired) quantity sits against its thresholds — the Bin Card's Min SL / EOP columns.
StockLevel.title: StockLevel

client_reference.description: The client's idempotency key, if it sent one.

StoreDeliveryNoteRequest.description:
Shape validation for POST /facilities/{facility}/delivery-notes. Ledger
rules (known batch expiry, back-dating) are checked when the note is
confirmed, by StockLedgerService.

source.description: Supplier or warehouse; becomes the receipts' "Received from".

capture_method.description: "ocr" when the lines were read from a photo on the device and reviewed by staff.

confirm.description: Confirm straight away (post the receipts) instead of saving a draft.

client_reference.description: Idempotency key: re-sending it returns the note already created.

StoreDeliveryNoteRequest.title: StoreDeliveryNoteRequest

StoreStockTransactionRequest.description:
Shape validation for POST /facilities/{facility}/stock-transactions.
State-dependent checks (unknown batch, insufficient stock, back-dating)
live in StockLedgerService and also come back as 422s.

client_reference.description: Idempotency key (e.g. a UUID from an offline outbox). Re-sending it returns the entry already recorded.

StoreStockTransactionRequest.title: StoreStockTransactionRequest

TransactionType.description: Stock Card row types. quantity is always >= 0; the direction comes from the type. This is the single definition of how each type moves a balance — StockLedgerService and ReconcileStockBalances both go through apply().
TransactionType.title: TransactionType

node.description: The hierarchy node this account is anchored at; drives which dashboard the client opens.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
